# Colgrid

> Colgrid is a real-world team game that turns a city into missions. Teams meet in one walkable neighborhood for a 2–4 hour gathering and take on quests hosted by local makers, kitchens and guides. Players earn XP, levels and badges on a web pass that carries forward to every gathering and every city, building toward an annual flagship. Chapter 01 is Salt Lake City, Utah.

## Key facts

- What it is: a persistent real-world team game (not a one-off outing). Your team, level and badges carry forward.
- Where: Salt Lake City (Chapter 01). Each gathering is in one walkable neighborhood; the starting location is revealed 24–48 hours before.
- Format: 30–50 players per gathering, in teams, for 2–4 hours. Season 1 has four gatherings.
- Who it's for: people who want more from a night out than dinner and drinks: friend groups, newcomers and solo players. Solo players are placed on a team.
- Two ways to play: every team plays casually by default and nobody is ranked. Teams can opt into the tournament before the season's second session to climb the chapter standings, play the Chapter Finals and compete for the Championship. The tournament costs nothing extra.
- Price: $75 per player per gathering, or $280 for all four with a Season Pass. No other discounts.
- A ticket includes: 3–4 hosted quests and materials, a finale meal and first drink, a numbered session badge, a printed quest passport, and the web pass.
- Progress never goes down: XP only goes up, and levels and badges are never taken away. Nothing is ranked or rewarded by money spent.
- Status: the Salt Lake pilot season is being built; tickets open soon.
- Contact: colgridco@gmail.com
